questions.question: Which language should the browser game use?
questions.rationale: A small standalone game can run directly in a browser without a compilation or server dependency.

options.label: JavaScript
options.description: Run directly in modern browsers with no build step.

options.label: TypeScript
options.description: Add static typing with a compilation step.

questions.question: What frontend framework or approach should be used?
questions.rationale: A framework-free implementation best fits a local-only, self-contained game and avoids altering REA product code.

options.label: Vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
options.description: A lightweight browser-native implementation with no runtime framework dependency.

questions.question: What game behavior and content should be included?
questions.answer: Create an original educational sorting game: classify ocean items into appropriate categories to support marine life; use original text, illustrations, and screen design; provide clear feedback and a replayable score/progress loop; support keyboard and touch input; run fully offline with no account, telemetry, backend, or external assets.
questions.rationale: Captures the requested educational idea while keeping content original, private, and self-contained.
questions.recommendedChoice: Original, accessible classification gameplay with local scoring and feedback.

questions.question: Which data stores are required?
questions.rationale: The standalone game can keep session state in memory and needs no persistence or remote services.

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: No database, storage account, cache, or queue is needed.

options.label: Local browser storage
options.description: Persist optional settings or best score on the user's device.

questions.question: Should users sign in for application features?
questions.rationale: The game is local-only and does not provide account-based features.

options.label: Yes
options.description: Users sign in to access application features.

options.label: No
options.description: The game is usable without signing in.
